headline: Tuesday, November 17 — the dry day: rain and gusts return tonight, heavy storm Wednesday.

sections.lead: Dry all day, then rain and gusts move back in tonight.
items: Tue Nov 17: partly sunny, 58/42, dry all day; rain returns tonight, 75% overnight with gusts to 39 mph
Wed Nov 18: heavy rain 85%, 48/42, gusts to 31 mph, about 2.3 inches
Thu Nov 19: rain 75%, 54/43 · Fri Nov 20: sunny, 55/41
Sat Nov 21: light rain 40%, 52/40 · Sun Nov 22: mostly cloudy, 35%, 54/45
Today hourly: 5am 42° clear · 8am 43° · 11am 52° · 1pm 55° · 3pm 56° · 6pm 51° · 10pm 48°, under 1% rain all day
sections.body: Use the dry window: nothing wet on the roads again until late tonight, and Wednesday is the storm day.

sections.lead: A steady-strength day with one comms snag: double-check anything you send.
